title: Two-beat cardiac memory yields calibration-sensitive age-transfer gains without improved discrimination
abstract: Lag-two partial RR correlation reduced age-group transfer logloss beyond conventional HRV and lag-one correlation by 0.102723 from Fantasia to NSR2 and 0.137063 in reverse. Source-plus-target bootstrap intervals included zero ([-0.189584,0.382388] and [-0.001724,0.446466]); AUC fell slightly in both directions. Calibration diagnostics and regularization sensitivity prevent a robust incremental-biomarker claim. This is exploratory separate-collection analysis, not untouched or verified participant-disjoint confirmation.
